evidence.claim: Figure 的 Helix 2.5 在 30 个未见过的真实家庭中执行三项整身任务，且没有在这些环境中采集数据、微调或适配。
evidence.excerpt: Then we took the robot into 30 Bay Area homes with zero data collected in any of them . Key Results Zero-shot whole-body autonomy across 30 real homes. Helix 2.5 performs three long-horizon behaviors across 30 unseen homes, with no data collection, fine-tuning, or adaptation in those environments or manipulated objects.

evidence.claim: 同样的任务数据，随机初始化模型零样本成功率为 9%，Index 预训练模型为 56%。
evidence.excerpt: In blind evaluations, the policy trained from scratch succeeded on 9% of zero-shot trials. The Index-pretrained policy succeeded on 56%

evidence.claim: Helix 2.5 用一半的任务特定数据达到与 Helix 02 相当的成功率，并把行为扩展到 30 个未见家庭。
evidence.excerpt: Helix 02 was trained with data collected directly in the environment where it was evaluated. Helix 2.5 matched its success rate while using half as much adaptation data - and did so zero-shot across 30 unseen homes.

evidence.claim: π0 把预训练视觉语言模型与流匹配动作专家结合，用多平台机器人数据训练通用策略。
evidence.excerpt: We propose a novel flow matching architecture built on top of a pre-trained vision-language model (VLM) to inherit Internet-scale semantic knowledge. We then discuss how this model can be trained on a large and diverse dataset from multiple dexterous robot platforms, including single-arm robots, dual-arm robots, and mobile manipulators.

evidence.claim: GR00T N1 采用双系统视觉-语言-动作架构，并用真实轨迹、人类视频和合成数据混合训练。
evidence.excerpt: GR00T N1 is a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model with a dual-system architecture. The vision-language module (System 2) interprets the environment through vision and language instructions. The subsequent diffusion transformer module (System 1) generates fluid motor actions in real time. Both modules are tightly coupled and jointly trained end-to-end. We train GR00T N1 with a heterogeneous mixture of real-robot trajectories, human videos, and synthetically generated datasets.

research.summary: Figure 在 2026 年 9 月发布 Helix 2.5，用大规模人类行为数据 Index 预训练一个整身人形策略，并在 30 个未见家庭中零样本执行整理、叠毛巾和铺床。公司自评的对照实验显示，Index 预训练把零样本成功率从 9% 提到 56%，任务特定数据需求约减半。它与 NVIDIA GR00T N1 的双系统 VLA、Physical Intelligence π0 的流匹配 VLA 指向同一方向：机器人开始复用通用视觉-语言知识与跨平台数据，而不是为每个房间重写策略。需要保留的边界是：56% 仍不是稳定完成率，结果来自公司自己的盲评与固定检查点，尚未由独立第三方复现。
